# Squirrel Brain — full descriptions of public product pages

> Companion to https://squirrelbrainapp.com/llms.txt. These are the public product pages listed in https://squirrelbrainapp.com/sitemap.xml, described in each page's own words. This file does not add reviews, ratings, or statistics.

Squirrel Brain is an iOS app. It is pre-launch: humans join a launch list. The MCP server is already live for agents and developers.

## Home
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/

Squirrel Brain | AI Reminder App for Voice Notes, Photos & Screenshots

The second brain that rings you back. You're not forgetful — you're outnumbered. Speak it. Snap it. Stash it. Your squirrel files everything — and for the one thing you can't miss, it calls your phone — and you can talk right back.

Squirrel Brain is an AI reminder app that turns voice notes, photos, screenshots, texts, and emails into reminders, alarms, and calendar events — and for the one thing you can't miss, it calls your phone.

## For AI agents / MCP
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/mcp

The MCP memory + delivery layer for your AI agents | Squirrel Brain

Give your agents a memory — and a phone line to you. Every agent you run is trapped in its window: it forgets between sessions, and it can't reach you once you've walked away from the screen. Squirrel Brain is the missing half — one persistent brain your whole fleet shares, plus a real line to your phone: a push, a spoken message, or an actual call it places itself.

Squirrel Brain is an MCP server that gives your AI agents a persistent shared brain and a real line to your phone — set alarms, read your day, file what they find, and place an actual voice call. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, or any agent you run.

One brain your whole fleet shares: not a vector store you bolt on and babysit. It's the same brain the human uses — so what your coding agent files, your research agent (and the person) can find later. Memory survives the session, the tool, and the model. Semantic search, a daily brief, boards, and a forever-note that never gets wiped.

A line to the human's actual phone: when something can't wait, your agent places a real phone call and speaks — or fires an escalating alarm, or a push. It reaches the human in the physical world, on its own, unattended.

Mint a key in the app, point your agent at the portal, and it acts on your brain. Each agent gets a personal API key, scoped to one brain and killable in a tap. Every write is attributed to the agent that created it. The server verifies the real effect before it confirms. Per-agent and fleet-wide cost ceilings are enforced server-side.

## Agent skills
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/skills

Agent skills that can call their human

Your agent got stuck. It called you. Download the complete loop: a useful phone briefing, your spoken answer, delivery back to the right task, and proof that the decision moved the work forward. Free for Squirrel Brain users.

Free Squirrel Brain agent skills for human escalation: place a clear phone call, listen for the answer, route it back to the right task, and verify follow-through.

Contact Your Human is a secure, reusable human-in-the-loop skill for any agent. It calls with useful context and options, captures the spoken reply, routes it, and verifies the result. Supervisor Loop is a dedicated watchdog for multiple work sessions. It detects stalls, verifies real artifacts, nudges the right task, and calls only after a verified question has waited at least five minutes.

The loop on the page: the agent recognizes a real decision, repeated failure, or unsafe impasse; it names the task, describes verified state, gives numbered options, and recommends one; Squirrel Brain rings the human's iPhone and speaks the complete decision brief; the skill polls the private MCP Portal for the new spoken answer; the answer goes back to the owning task, and artifact progress proves it was applied.

## For work
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/work

For Work — Capture, Follow-Ups & GPS Proof

Your brain has too many tabs open. For sales reps, service techs, and contractors. Every job detail captured the moment it happens. Every follow-up handled before end of day.

Squirrel Brain for sales reps, service techs, and contractors. Voice capture, GPS photo proof, Outlook import, and follow-ups that ring your phone.

Voice capture — say it, it's saved: walk out of a meeting and talk through what just happened. Your squirrel extracts the follow-ups, the promised callbacks, and the dates. GPS-stamped photo proof: snap what you left on-site; your squirrel reads the photo, logs the job details, and stores a timestamped record with GPS. A good-morning email opens the workday with today's meetings, the follow-ups you owe, and anything you captured that's still open. A 4 PM nudge email recaps what's still open and what's due tomorrow. Follow-ups that matter ring your phone — a real call that rings when your ringer's on, vibrates on silent like any call, and reaches you on a locked screen. LinkStash saves links from Safari, YouTube, or anywhere else, organized by source, findable later in plain language.

## For the family
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/family

For the Family

The whole family in one brain. Snap schedules, receipts, permission slips, and meds. Your squirrel reads every photo, sets every alarm, and reminds you before anything slips. Reads every calendar already on your iPhone — nothing new to connect.

Squirrel Brain for busy parents. Snap a soccer schedule and get every game as an alarm. Receipts, pix boards, morning brief with weather and a joke — all organised.

Pix boards — for every pile on the counter: receipts, recipes, meds, school permission slips. Snap three of a kind and the board makes itself. Return-window reminders: snap a receipt and your squirrel reads the store and the amount, then asks if you want a reminder before the return window closes. Voice recall: open the Burrow and ask — your squirrel searches everything you've ever captured and answers back in plain language.

## Pricing
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/pricing

Pricing

Free to use

Squirrel Brain is free to use at launch. There is nothing to buy and no trial to start. Paid plans may come later, and we will say so clearly before anyone is asked to pay.

## Developer docs
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/mcp-docs

Developer Docs — Squirrel Brain MCP Server

Connect Any AI Agent to Your Brain. Squirrel Brain has a built-in MCP server. Any AI agent — Claude, a custom agent, or your own automation — can read your tasks, create alarms, and send voice messages directly to your phone.

Connect any AI agent to Squirrel Brain via MCP. Create alarms, read tasks, send voice messages to your phone — all from Claude or any agent.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that lets AI agents call tools on external services. Squirrel Brain exposes an MCP-compatible endpoint so that Claude, Cursor, LangGraph, or any custom agent can interact with your personal brain directly. An agent can read your tasks, create notes and checklists, set alarms on your phone, send push notifications, make a voice call, fetch your daily brief, and write persistent context notes. All actions are tied to your account via your API key. Only you can access your brain. The page is for developers, technical founders, and power users who want to wire Claude or a custom agent into their Squirrel Brain account. If you just want to use the app, no setup is needed.

AI Reminder App for iPhone — From Capture to Done | Squirrel Brain

The AI reminder app for everything you forget. Speak it, snap it, or screenshot it — Squirrel Brain turns scattered information into reminders, alarms, notes, and calendar events, then makes sure you follow through.

The AI reminder app for iPhone: speak it, snap it, or screenshot it, and Squirrel Brain turns it into the reminder, alarm, note, or calendar event — then follows through, with a real phone call for the one you can't miss.

Most reminder apps make you stop, type, and set a time. Squirrel Brain meets you where the thought happens. Say it out loud, snap a photo, screenshot a message, or forward a text or email — the AI reads it, pulls out what matters, and turns it into something that actually nudges you. A note app just holds your words until you go looking for them. Squirrel Brain acts: it sets the alarm, adds the calendar event, files the photo onto the right board, and calls you when something genuinely can't slip.

## Turn screenshots into reminders
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/screenshot-to-reminder-app

Alarm Screenshot — Screenshot to Alarm or Reminder | Squirrel Brain

Turn a screenshot into an alarm or reminder. Screenshot a text, an email, an appointment, or a to-do — Squirrel Brain reads it and turns it into a reminder, alarm, or calendar event so it never gets buried in your camera roll.

Alarm screenshot: screenshot a text, email, appointment, or to-do and Squirrel Brain turns it into a reminder, alarm, or calendar event — so the things you screenshot don't vanish in your camera roll.

Send a screenshot to Squirrel Brain and the AI reads the text in the image — the date, the time, the task, the name. It turns that into a reminder, a calendar event, or a loud alarm, and it can start a live countdown on your home screen. You review and confirm before anything is set. It is built for messages you can't act on directly, including a company inbox you can't sync.

## Turn photos into reminders
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/photo-to-reminder-app

Photo to Reminder App — Turn Photos Into Searchable Notes | Squirrel Brain

Turn photos into searchable notes and reminders. Take a picture of something that matters — a receipt, a whiteboard, a parking spot, a schedule — and Squirrel Brain reads it, files it, and makes it searchable and actionable.

Take a photo of something important and Squirrel Brain makes it searchable and actionable — receipts, whiteboards, parking spots, serial numbers, and schedules become reminders and notes you can find later.

Squirrel Brain reads text, dates, and details out of the photo, auto-sorts photos onto boards — receipts, meds, schedules, parking — and lets you search by what's in the picture, in plain language. Photos can be stored with a timestamp and GPS location, which is useful as proof of delivery, service, or install for field work. It is just as useful for everyday life: receipts, fridge schedules, parking spots, and handwritten notes.

## Can ChatGPT set a reminder on my iPhone?
https://squirrelbrainapp.com/can-chatgpt-set-iphone-reminder

Can ChatGPT Set a Reminder on My iPhone? | Squirrel Brain

Can ChatGPT set a reminder on your iPhone? Short answer: no. ChatGPT and Claude can only nudge you inside their own app — they can't fire a real iPhone alarm or reminder. Squirrel Brain is the app that actually does it: say it, snap it, or forward it, and it becomes a real alarm — even a phone call.

ChatGPT and Claude can't set a real alarm or reminder on your iPhone on their own — their tasks only fire inside their app. Squirrel Brain does the job itself — and MCP-capable agents like Claude Code can drive it directly.

Squirrel Brain has a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. You generate a personal key in the app, connect an MCP-capable agent — Claude Code, Cursor, or one you run yourself — and it can set an alarm, create a reminder, read your day, file a note, and trigger a phone-call-style reminder on your actual phone. Consumer ChatGPT can't connect custom MCP servers yet. You don't need an AI agent to use the app: speak it, snap it, or screenshot it and it becomes a reminder.

Squirrel Brain doesn't just remind you — it calls you. It's a real phone call — it rings when your ringer's on and vibrates on silent — and when you pick up, an AI voice actually talks to you: your day, a pep talk, or a quick prep before your next meeting.

It rings on your ringer, vibrates on silent, and shows on a locked screen. An AI voice speaks your reminder and your day — not a canned recording. You can schedule recurring check-in, pep-talk, or daily-encouragement calls, or a prep call before a meeting that covers your key points. You decide which reminders escalate to a call and which stay as a normal nudge.

Squirrel Brain turns your AI into a real AI reminder agent: connect Claude Code, Cursor, or any agent you run to its built-in MCP server and it sets real alarms, reminders, and calendar events on your iPhone — and can even call your phone.

Connect your agent with a personal key and it gets a real toolset: set an alarm, create a reminder or note, read your daily brief, save a link, append to a forever note, and trigger a phone-call-style reminder — every action logged to the agent that made it.
